[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if n < 2 then
  false
else
  let rec is_prime' (n: Nat) (k: Nat): Bool :=
    if k * k > n then
      true
    else
      n % k ≠ 0 ∧ is_prime' n (k + 1)
  is_prime' n 2
[END]
